response_keys: CREATE TABLE "response_keys" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key")) STRICT
delivery_sources: CREATE TABLE "delivery_sources" ("offset" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (offset>=0), "length" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (length>0), "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seq>0), "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sender_lookup" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("seq")) STRICT
context_manifest_sources: CREATE TABLE "context_manifest_sources" ("offset" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (offset>=0), "length" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (length>0), "thread" TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
addressed: CREATE TABLE "addressed" ("lookup" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "delivery_sources" ("seq"), PRIMARY KEY ("lookup", "seq")) STRICT
prefix_certificate: CREATE TABLE "prefix_certificate" ("singleton" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("singleton" IN (1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("version" IN (2)), "root_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device" INTEGER NOT NULL, "inode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset" INTEGER NOT NULL, "through_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "tail" TEXT NOT NULL, "mtime_ns" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ctime_ns" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("singleton")) STRICT
